_doc: Reel Reads library: every book a professor recommended to Arthur or he captured via Ambidex, growing until release. One entry per book. status: 'seed' = in the v1 feed (Docs/Reel Reads Specifications.md, Seed catalogue), 'queued' = in the library, no cards yet, 'carded' = cards generated. Only add a book with a traceable source (course, session, or Arthur's own capture). Never atomise a course's Primary readings with AI where the course bans it (Massey OIDD/LGST 6930 does).
